name: HannStar Display Corporation
summary: HannStar Display Corporation engages in research, design, manufacture, sale, and repair of thin film transistor liquid crystal displays ans touch panels in Taiwan. The company is also involved in TFT-LCD panels, flat panel displays, surveillance cameras, and related components business. In addition, the company produces and sells monitors. It serves smart automotive, industrial display, smartphone, wearable, tablet, touch device, and IT display sectors. HannStar Display Corporation was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
